Borrowing the mower

The petrol mower is kept under a cover by the north fence, and any member who has been shown how to start it may use it on the grass paths. Fill it up from the green can before you put it away, wipe the blades with the rag, and tell a warden if it does not run as it should.

Marsh Lane Allotments, 4 Marsh Lane. Open from dawn to dusk.
